evals.expected_output: Full briefing across all configured sources with unified summary and suggested actions
expectations: Attempts to query all configured data sources (email, chat, calendar, work items, PRs)
Presents a unified summary, not separate tool dumps
Shows today's calendar as compact timeline
Ends with 2-5 suggested next actions linking to harness skills

evals.prompt: catch me up on just email and PRs
evals.expected_output: Focused briefing covering only email and pull requests
expectations: Only queries email and PR sources, skips chat/calendar/work items
Still presents unified format with suggested actions

evals.prompt: what did I miss since yesterday (no MCP servers configured)
evals.expected_output: Graceful fallback to git-only context with setup guidance
expectations: Detects that MCP servers are unavailable
Falls back to git context (recent commits, branch, triage branches)
Suggests running /setup to configure MCP servers
Does not crash or show raw error messages

evals.prompt: good morning, give me the rundown before standup in 10 minutes
evals.expected_output: Time-aware briefing that prioritizes urgent items and upcoming meeting
expectations: Prioritizes blockers and items relevant to standup discussion
Keeps summary concise given time constraint
